text:
[issue by Tlp300]
Was told to bring this here, so...

**Bug explanation:**
Having owolib installed alongside Pastel seems to break Pastel's black hole chest, causing it to not suck up items at all when filters are set on it.

**To reproduce:**
1. Install Pastel and owolib
2. Place a Black Hole Chest
3. Set a filter
4. Watch it become unable to suck in items

[owo-lib-neoforge-0.12.15.1-beta.3+1.21]
